title: The UNIX Time-Sharing System
lineage: Revised 1978 article explicitly identifies itself as a revision of 1974 and 1973 papers. Early PDP-7 system dates c.1969–70; PDP-11 Unix was operational February 1971; by this 1978 version authors report more than 600 installations. Do not attribute 1978 counts or later architecture to 1974.
